integrity: The infinite-family statement is proved analytically. Exhaustive computation on all K_{m,n} with 1<=m,n<=5 is used only as a finite stress test. Unindexed parallel work remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Specific to three-colour forcing on finite simple complete bipartite graphs with two nonempty parts; no extension to arbitrary bipartite or multipartite graphs is claimed. Some small biclique special cases were already known.
title: Forced three-colouring polynomial of complete bipartite graphs
